findings.title: retryCount cleanup deletes EMAIL/WHATSAPP reminders
findings.body: The deleteMany OR's second branch is { retryCount: { gt: 1 } } with no method filter, so any WorkflowReminder of any method with retryCount > 1 is deleted. Only SMS reminders ever get retryCount incremented by this cron, but EMAIL/WHATSAPP rows share the table and default, and any future/other writer setting retryCount will cause cross-method data loss. Scope the branch to method SMS, e.g. AND method SMS with retryCount > 1.

findings.title: Non-atomic retryCount increment can lose retries
findings.body: Both failure paths do data: { retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 } using the value read earlier in findMany. Concurrent cron executions or overlapping runs will both read the same value and write back the same increment, losing one retry and delaying deletion indefinitely for persistently failing numbers. Use atomic increment: data: { retryCount: { increment: 1 } }.

findings.title: Missing sendTo/empty message never retried or cleaned up
findings.body: When message is empty or sendTo is falsy (e.g. invalid/missing phone number, the exact case in the PR description) the code falls through the if without any prisma update. retryCount is never incremented so the reminder is refetched on every cron run until its scheduledDate passes, defeating the retry-limit. Increment retryCount or delete in that no-op path as well.
